newsitem.title: USA: Physician Reliance sees Q4 on par with Q3.
newsitem.headline: Physician Reliance sees Q4 on par with Q3.

text.p: Physician Reliance Network Inc said on Monday that it hopes to add several physician groups to its network through the remainder of 1996 and thus expects to achieve operating results in the fourth quarter similar to those of the third quarter.
The company said it should see improvements in margins in 1997 as more networks are integrated, but these will be somewhat offset by litigation expenses related to previously announced lowsuits.

The company reported third quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) of $12.7 million, compared with $8.5 million in the prior year period. Net income per share remained flat at $0.10.
